title: Signed cylinder propagation and marked polygons on the honeycomb lattice
summary: At the critical activity and loop fugacity two, we prove a 1/6 partition exponent for disjoint honeycomb polygons separating opposite marks on a balanced infinite cylinder, and a 1/12 planar nesting exponent. For ordered first-exit chords in a regular hexagon of side R , with both boundary ports summed and diameter at least $`R/10`$, the finite critical partition is $`R^{3/4+o(1)}`$ and the normalized mean length is $`R^{4/3+o(1)}`$.
